name: Asian Paints Ltd
one_liner: Asian Paints accelerated revenue growth to 12% TTM, but operating margins compressed to 15.6% as inflation offset price increases.

name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
one_liner: HAL offers zero debt and strong cash flow, but consistently misses management's revenue growth guidance despite expanding order books.

name: HDFC Bank Ltd
one_liner: HDFC Bank delivers steady profit growth alongside accelerating quarterly revenue, though management continues to avoid specific quantitative targets.

name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd
one_liner: IndiGo exhibits accelerating top-line growth and positive cash conversion, countered by heavy losses, compressed operating margins, and severe balance sheet leverage.

name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
one_liner: Kaynes delivers rapid revenue growth of 35% but burns cash heavily, with negative free cash flow accumulating to ₹3,288 cr.

name: Reliance Industries Ltd
one_liner: Reliance delivers strong headline revenue growth of 20% and a PAT of Rs 95,625 cr, but 12 guidance items remain unmeasured.

name: Titan Company Ltd
one_liner: Titan shows soaring top and bottom-line growth, but cash conversion is poor and leverage has risen sharply.
